component.name: NBA JAM Recomp
component.summary: The NBA JAM arcade games, recompiled; bring your own ROMs

description.p: Plays NBA JAM, Tournament Edition, T.E. Special Edition, NBA Hangtime and Maximum Hangtime from your own ROM files. No game data is included.

ul.li: Widescreen for every game, with original 4:3 and stretch
Menus that work with a controller alone
Lua mods, shaders and save states

description.p: Drag your ROM files onto the window, or use Open my ROM folder in the main menu.
